reviews.text: Stone Bison General Construction made our roof replacement, gutters and windows "like new" after a recent hail storm.  They also were always prompt on appointments and cleaned up perfectly. They had great communication and were always positive.  Their work with our insurance company really made it go smooth.  Highly recommend them!!!!
reviews.author: Jim Bryan

reviews.text: Stone Bison is a five star company! I had them replace roofs on two homes.Chris walked me through the process of dealing with my insurance company and a difficult HOA committee. To say they are knowledgeable and professional is an understatement! We will absolutely use them again. Bonus, is that my yearly home insurance premiums were nearly cut in half because of the new and better quality roof shingles.
reviews.author: Cindy Melendez

reviews.text: I am very proud to recommend Mr. Caleb Dees and the folks at Stone Bison Construction for any and all construction needs.  Prompt, responsive, and professional service.  Particular attention to detail.  Replaced my roof in Burleson (Tarrant County) about a year and a half ago.  Excellent work and quick turn around.  With the recent storms, Caleb got on my request for inspection right away and got the information that I needed.  Thanks so much.
reviews.author: Shannon Goble

reviews.text: Great company to work with! We have worked with them several times on different homes and they are always responsive and professional. They will walk you through the process and help navigate working with the insurance companies. Great communication. Highly recommend Stone Bison General Construction!
reviews.author: Mindy Potts (PottsRealtyGroup)

reviews.text: Stone Bison was so great to work with. We had some roof damage from the recent storms and they came out so quickly. Very professional, friendly, and cut straight to the chase. Michael told me what we needed and didn’t try to oversell us on anything! I will definitely be using them for any roofing repairs and anything else in the future! Great company!
reviews.author: Haley Little

reviews.text: Stone Bison took care of redoing my roof without any issues. The team did and outstanding job putting on my new roof. They cleaned up all the debris and I have very minimal disturbance working from my home office. These guys went above and beyond. I would recommend Michael and Caleb to do your next job. These guys “Get the job done”. Awesome!!!
reviews.author: James Little

reviews.text: Stone Bison is AMAZING! We are so grateful for the professionalism and expertise of the staff and construction employees. Our home and free standing garage look great and revived with new roofs. Thanks a million!
reviews.author: Deni Jeff

reviews.text: Love my new roof! Michael  was awesome and I would recommend him to anybody! Customer service was top notch! 100 recommend this company!
reviews.author: Ryan Doughty

data.summary: The reviews are overwhelmingly authentic. The detailed, varied, and specific content of the Google reviews aligns with a quality contractor. The substantial and strong rating on Angi (4.4 from 803 reviews) is a powerful signal of legitimate, widespread customer satisfaction over time. There is no evidence of manipulation or fake reviews.
fake_signals: Low review count on Google (21) for a company with 800+ on Angi could indicate selective solicitation, but not definitive.
authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific details: project types (roof replacement, gutters, windows), crew names (Chris, Caleb, Michael), locations (Burleson, Tarrant County), and interactions with insurance/HOA.
Varied writing styles and perspectives from different authors.
Emotionally authentic praise and specific outcomes mentioned (e.g., insurance premium cut in half).
High-volume Angi rating (4.4 from 803 reviews) strongly indicates a legitimate, established business with a broad customer base.
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent and positive across Google (5.0), BBB (A), and Angi (4.4). The Angi rating is slightly lower but based on a very high volume of reviews (803), which is a normal distribution for a long-established business.
